rows.surface: Actual Facebook User-Agent producer fields and Mozilla-prefix hardware/OS consistency
rows.mechanism: Current FBSharedFramework _FBUserAgent at 0x413a98 returns an Objective-C object via independently resolved retain/autorelease stubs. Ten original-app producer observations expose bounded model/OS/scale/locale and app-version/build fields plus a Mozilla system prefix. This covers producer evidence, not request transmission.
rows.verification: 20-second fixed-original-app capture, 10 allowlisted UA records; offline privacy guards passed; no probe-error events. Dynamic fields were not rewritten. Initial dyld attach failure produced no accepted evidence; fresh launches succeeded.
rows.fix: FBUA-001 now implements and host-tests the observed prefix/block policy with preserved real app/server metadata. Actual clone interception, first-use timing, broader SDK/defaults/transport and managed routing remain unverified; do not enable Facebook from original producer or host evidence alone.
